tpt_listing.description: The ultimate 10-page progressive Addition Within 10 unit for Kindergarten and Grade 1! Starts with concrete visual counting (pictures, ten frames, dominoes) and progresses step-by-step through number lines, number bonds, drills, vertical math, missing addends, word problems, and a fun color-by-number review. Includes 10 complete answer keys for rapid grading.
